name: Discord Wastes: Rifts
summary: The deepest rupture zone of the Discord Wastes, dominated by massive rifts and arcane storms.
description: Discord Wastes Rifts is the most unstable and dangerous part of the Wastes. Massive rifts tear open the terrain, gravity distorts unpredictably, and arcane storms surge without warning. Discord manifestations are far more aggressive here, and Muramite observers avoid the area entirely. The Rifts represent the purest expression of Discord’s corruption, where reality itself breaks apart.
